# <span id="aanchor425"></span> System Factors

Use the System Factors screen to specify default settings for systems that you define in FLOWCAL. These settings are datetime effective. If multiple records exist in the database, use the buttons below the **Effective Date** and **Eff. End Date** fields to scroll through the records.

<div class="procedure">

To access the System Factors screen:

1.  Go to **Settings** \> **Settings Manager**.
2.  In the **System** group, select **System Factors**.
    

<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 600;height: 500;" />  

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Calculation and Reporting Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Calculation and Reporting Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Calculation and Reporting Options">

The following options specify how FLOWCAL calculates certain values for analysis and reporting:

- **Heating Value Condition** - The heating value condition under which FLOWCAL analyzes gas stream samples.
- **Base Pressure** - The base pressure that FLOWCAL uses to calculate standard values.
- **Base Temperature** - The base temperature that FLOWCAL uses to calculate standard values.
- **Density of Air** - The base air density and measurement unit that FLOWCAL uses to calculate standard values.
- **Density of Water** - The base water density and measurement unit that FLOWCAL uses to calculate standard values.
- **Company Name** - Company name will display in the top right corner of Crystal reports. (See [Report Display Options](../../Reports/Report%20Display%20Options.md) for display precedence.)
- **Liquid Rounding** - If you select **Yes**, FLOWCAL applies a carry/borrow method to liquid meters when allocating batch, monthly, or daily accumulated values down to the periodics. This ensures that the sum of periodics corresponds correctly with the batch, monthly, or daily values when rolling back up from the periodics. This applies to imports and edits at the batch, monthly, and daily resolution.
- **Component Totals \[Hi Limit\]** - The default maximum set point for meter analysis data. [Meter exception 106](../../Exceptions/Exception%20Directory/0-999/100-199.md) will be generated if the component total falls above maximum limit.
- **Component Totals \[Lo Limit\]** - The default minimum set point for meter analysis data. [Meter exception 105](../../Exceptions/Exception%20Directory/0-999/100-199.md) will be generated if the component total falls below the minimum limit.
- **Contract Hour** - If not specified at the meter level, the contract hour that FLOWCAL applies to meters and uses in reports.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="C6+ Split Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />C6+ Split Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="C6+ Split Options">

C6+ splits provide for the C6+ properties to be calculated from a fixed ratio of pure component (C6 through C10) properties. This fixed split ratio is used by meters when applying the GPA-2172 corrections when the meter is not assigned to a quality source.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Ticket Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Ticket Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Ticket Options">

The following options specify the default configuration for Conversion tickets:

- **Pressure Gauge** - The pressure that FLOWCAL uses to calculate correction factors.
- **Atmospheric Pressure** - If FLOWCAL uses gauge pressure to calculate correction factors, the atmospheric pressure and measurement unit to use in the calculation.

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Additional Options">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Additional Options</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Additional Options">

You can specify the following additional options:

- **Dry Gas Max Water** - The maximum allowable water-vapor content for dry gas samples.
- **Ignore Standalone Samples with Duplicate IDs** - If you select **Yes**, FLOWCAL ignores a standalone sample with the same ID as an existing sample during imports.

</div>
